examples.text: Jabłuszka ukąsisz i na ziemię kiniesz.
examples.translation: You will bite the apple and throw it on the ground.
examples.english: You will bite the apple and throw it on the ground.

examples.text: Pan Bóg umacał palic w wodzie i kinoł za siebie i zrobił sie amniół
examples.translation: God touched his finger with water and sprinkled it behind him and an angel was made.
examples.english: God touched his finger with water and sprinkled it behind him and an angel was made.

examples.text: Co kinie za siebie, to staje dziesięć amniołów.
examples.translation: Whoever sprinkles behind himself, ten angels stand.
examples.english: Whoever sprinkles behind himself, ten angels stand.

examples.text: Pan Bóg zjabłu tez kinął kilka ziarnek owsa.
examples.translation: The Lord God also sprinkled a few oat grains on the apple.
examples.english: The Lord God also sprinkled a few oat grains on the apple.

examples.translation: The rain won't sprinkle on me.
examples.english: The rain won't sprinkle on me.

glosses: dać znać kiwnięciem głowy lub ręki
